0010| ### Added
0011| 
0012| - Open an interactive session when the client starts with no arguments — `forgel-code` now shows a prompt and stays open instead of printing usage text. A sentence typed at the prompt is handed to the engine's project agent as one free-form request and the agent's answer is shown in the session. The session shows the selected project and lets the owner switch it without leaving, shows a plan as its ordered tasks with their states and a new task with its title and state, and re-reads the task and release state from the engine on its own so progress appears without asking for a status. Accepting a task, sending it back with remarks, retrying a failed task, pausing and resuming work are asked for in plain language, an ambiguous or unmatched request gets a clarification and performs nothing, a failure shows the reason and the next possible step while the session stays usable, and replies follow the language of the owner's message.
